justification: The case concerns the right to peaceful assembly (not association), the Court conducts a unified Article 11 merits analysis across the admissible complaints reaching standalone violation/no-violation findings, proceeds on facts treated as sufficiently established by domestic investigations, and concludes with a genuine Article 11 merits adjudication finding a violation in respect of the morning blockade of Usukhchay and no violation in respect of the Miskindzha dispersal and the first applicant's arrest.
